__1 Humming. 
__2 A cluster of blossoms, bunch of flowers, a nosegay; cf. गुच्छ. 
-Comp. 
-कृत् a large black bee.

[गुञ्ज्-अच्] 
__1 A small shrub of that name, bearing a red black berry; अन्तर्विषमया (for °य्यः) ह्येता बहिश्चैव मनोरमाः । गुञ्जाफलसमाकारा योषितः केन निर्मिताः ॥ [[Pt. 1. 196]]; किं जातु गुञ्जाफलभूषणानां सुवर्णकारेण वनेचराणाम् [[Vikr. 1. 25.]] 
__2 A berry of this shrub used as a weight, measuring on an average 1(5̭16) grains Troy, or an artificial weight called Gunja measuring about 2(3̭16) grains. 
__3 Humming, a low murmuring sound. 
__4 A kettle-drum; … गुञ्जा जुगुञ्जुः करघट्टिताः [[Bk. 14. 2.]] 
__5 A tavern. 
__6 Reflection, meditation. 
__7 A kind of plant with a poisonous root.
A berry of the Guñjā plant.
Humming, murmuring; स्वच्छन्दं दलदरविन्द ते मरन्दं विन्दन्तो विदधतु गुञ्जितं मिलिन्दाः [[Bv. 1. 15]]; न गुञ्जितं तन्न जहार यन्मनः [[Bk. 2. 19.]]
